items.title: Strive Adds $169M Bitcoin in Its Biggest Buy in Four Months
items.summary: The Nasdaq-listed bitcoin treasury company, co-founded by Vivek Ramaswamy, paid roughly $169 million for 2,000 coins last week and now holds 29,462 BTC.

items.title: Crypto PAC announces support for 32 House candidates in US midterms
items.summary: Fairshake said it would financially back 32 House candidates who all voted in favor of the CLARITY market structure bill in 2025, as the legislation remains in limbo in the Senate.

items.title: CFTC Staff Clears Fast Track for Stock-Index Perpetual Conversions
items.summary: Exchanges must give position holders five calendar days' notice and a chance to exit, while leaving other material contract terms unchanged.

items.title: Crypto's campaign arm, Fairshake, sets lists of U.S. House favorites it'll spend on
items.summary: The super PAC shared a list of more than 30 incumbent candidates it's backing, with about a million dollars going to three names from each party.
